test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Romesh opened a fixed deposits account in his bank for 3 years by depositing ₹80,000.The bank has promised to pay him compound interest annually at the rate of 7% per annum. What is the maturity value of his FDR? (Nearest to a ₹)
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount = Rs80,000

Time = 3 years

Rate = 7% per annum

**Formula used:**

Amount = P × ( 1 + R/100)^t

Where C.I. = Compound Interest, P = Principal, R= Rate , t = time

**Calculation:**

Amount = P × ( 1 + R/100)^t

⇒ Amount = 80,000 × ( 1+ 7/100)³ 

⇒ Amount = 80,000 × 107/100 × 107/100 × 107/100

⇒ Amount = 0.08 × 1225043 = Rs.98,003.44 ≈ 98,003

**∴ Maturity value of FDR is Rs98,003.**
